name: mix_server
description: Jira tools for accessing sprint information

endpoints.name: get_all_open_sprints
endpoints.description: Retrieves all active and future sprints from the Jira board. Returns a list of Sprint objects representing all open sprints in the Jira board, including details like ID, name, state, start date, and end date.

returns.description: A list of Sprint objects representing all open sprints in the Jira board. Returns an empty list if no sprints are found or if there's an API error.
